name: Relevance
description: The degree to which the response is relevant to the provided context and fact.

name: Creativity
description: The originality and creativity of the response in integrating the provided fact.

name: Engagement
description: The extent to which the response encourages further conversation or engagement.

name: Clarity
description: The clarity and coherence of the response in conveying the intended message.

name: Insightfulness
description: The depth and insightfulness of the response in relation to the context and fact.
